name: Dia sam
summary: Địa sâm is eaten fresh, grilled, stir-fried, fried, or as porridge, and dried to sweeten a cooking liquid. It is naturally sweet.
howToEat: Use it fresh in one of the four cooks, or dried to sweeten a liquid.
seoTitle: Dia sam — a sweet Can Gio specialty
seoDescription: Địa sâm is grilled, stir-fried, fried, or cooked as porridge, and dried to sweeten a liquid. It is naturally sweet.
taste: Naturally sweet, which is why dried địa sâm is used to sweeten a liquid.
